name: Kaseya Center
description: Waterfront arena on Biscayne Bay in downtown Miami that hosts Miami Heat basketball games and major concerts.
facts: Home arena of the NBA's Miami Heat.
Sits on the edge of Biscayne Bay in downtown Miami.

name: Bayside Marketplace
description: Open-air waterfront shopping and dining center on Biscayne Bay, a starting point for many Miami boat tours.
facts: Open-air market on the Biscayne Bay waterfront.
Many sightseeing boat tours leave from its marina.

name: Freedom Tower
description: Mediterranean Revival tower on Biscayne Boulevard, built in 1925 for the Miami News.
facts: Built in 1925 as the headquarters of the Miami News.
From 1962 to 1974 it processed Cuban refugees, earning the nickname the Ellis Island of the South.
Designated a National Historic Landmark in 2008.
